en: A multi-view color postcard showing modernist cityscapes. The left panel features a tall telecommunications tower with red-and-white bands rising above a green landscape and city in the distance. The upper-right panel shows a broad plaza with flowerbeds, pedestrians, and modern high-rise hotels and office buildings. The lower-right panel depicts a wide avenue with mid-20th-century cars parked along the street, large buildings on one side, a modern hall with a distinctive sloped roof, and landscaped lawns and flowerbeds. Across the middle, there is a title band with the word 'DRESDEN' and a German subtitle.
